intro.heading: Engineering experience with small-business flexibility.
intro.lead: TEYAC Investments (Pvt) Ltd, trading as TEYAC Construction (Pvt) Ltd, is a wholly Zimbabwean-owned engineering company incorporated on 26 June 2012.
intro.body1: We are a fast-growing civil, electrical, mechanical and telecommunications engineering company, offering design and construction as well as repair and maintenance contracting to industrial, commercial and infrastructure clients across Zimbabwe and beyond. Whether it’s a single service call or a multi-million-dollar project, our structure gives clients big-business solutions with small-business flexibility, quick response and fast turnaround.
intro.body2: Our expertise is evidenced by the quality of our past work in civil construction, structural-steel fabrication and erection, and telecommunications installations, repairs and maintenance. We maintain a database of some of the most qualified and experienced personnel in the field, backed by a best-practice S.H.E policy that keeps our people, our clients’ communities and the environment safe.

capabilities.heading: Capability across the complete project cycle.

items.title: Engineering & delivery
items.text: Our experience covers civil construction, structural-steel fabrication and erection, telecommunications installations, repairs and maintenance. We coordinate site teams, technical requirements and practical construction methods around the needs of each project.

items.title: Procurement & partnerships
items.text: We work with an established network of contractors, suppliers and sector partners. That network supports access to suitable equipment, operators, materials and specialist knowledge for projects of different sizes and technical demands.

items.title: People & supervision
items.text: TEYAC maintains access to qualified and experienced field personnel. Our management approach brings together planning, project implementation, site supervision and clear accountability to keep work progressing safely and efficiently.

items.title: Safety & responsibility
items.text: Our S.H.E practices are intended to provide a safe working environment for employees, surrounding communities and the natural environment. Safety, quality and responsible delivery are treated as project requirements—not afterthoughts.

process.heading: A clear path from enquiry to completion.
process.text: Every assignment is shaped around the client’s scope, site conditions and programme.

steps.title: Understand the requirement
steps.text: Review the project type, location, technical needs and available plans.

steps.title: Plan the solution
steps.text: Define the work method, resources, programme and commercial scope.

steps.title: Mobilise and deliver
steps.text: Coordinate personnel, materials, equipment and on-site execution.

steps.title: Supervise and report
steps.text: Monitor workmanship, safety, progress and communication.

steps.title: Complete and support
steps.text: Close out the work and provide maintenance support where required.

lines.heading: From site preparation to finished infrastructure.
lines.lead: TEYAC provides civil and earthwork engineering for industrial, telecommunications and development projects.

subservices.title: Base-station construction
subservices.text: Construction and maintenance services for telecommunications base-station civils.

subservices.title: Dams & catchment works
subservices.text: Design, construction and maintenance of dams, including catchment calculations and capacity-holding assessments.

subservices.title: Roads
subservices.text: Geo surveys and navigation designs, construction, surfacing, repair and maintenance.

subservices.title: Housing developments
subservices.text: Project layouts, waterway drainage, sewerage reticulation and house construction.

subservices.title: Site works & earthmoving
subservices.text: Site hardening, bulk earthworks, site preparation, hard-stand areas and contract cartage.

subservices.title: Plant hire & disposal
subservices.text: Earthmoving equipment and plant hire, plus supply and disposal of fill material — including specialist environmental earth-moving for contaminated material.

lines.heading: Fabrication, erection and dismantling.
lines.lead: We undertake structural steel projects of any magnitude — structural design, erection and dismantling — tailored to each client’s requirements.

subservices.title: GSM communication towers
subservices.text: Erection of communication towers up to 80m in height, including civil works — hot-dip galvanised and painted to local and international aviation standards.

subservices.title: Floodlight towers
subservices.text: Erection of floodlight towers up to 30m, including civils and electricals, in 3-leg or 4-leg designs, all hot-dip galvanised for corrosion protection.

subservices.title: Palisade fencing & burglar screens
subservices.text: Installation of hot-dip galvanised and/or painted tubular or angular palisade fencing and burglar screens.

subservices.title: Storage & structural steelwork
subservices.text: Storage spheres, roof trusses, staircases and stair rails.

lines.heading: Installation, upgrades and maintenance.
lines.lead: Our technical teams support wireless and fibre networks from site survey through installation, testing and maintenance.

subservices.title: BTS & RF installations
subservices.text: Upgrades and maintenance on BTS and RF installations, with specialist experience on hilltop and rooftop sites — cabinet assembly, shelter assembly, antenna mounting and RRU installations.

subservices.title: Microwave links
subservices.text: Installation and maintenance of microwave links in 1+0, 1+1, space-diversity and XPIC configurations, on NEC Pasolink V4 and Neo Pasolink equipment.

subservices.title: Optical fibre
subservices.text: Optical-fibre splicing and testing, including trenching, cable laying and local-authority liaison.

subservices.title: Site survey & planning
subservices.text: Site surveys, technical analysis, drive tests and upgrade planning for proposed network changes.
